parallels.note: The children of Bigvai, two thousand fifty-six.

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

translations.web: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”
translations.bsb: The total number of men in the camp of Dan is 157,600; they shall set out last, under their standards.”
translations.kjv: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
translations.asv: All that were numbered of the camp of Dan were a hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall set forth hindmost by their standards.
